memory.title: Mavi Marmara
memory.desc: The attack on the Freedom Flotilla, which set sail to break the siege of Gaza, left a deep mark on the world's conscience. The price of solidarity was heavy, but the memory endured.

memory.title: Freedom Flotilla
memory.desc: Over the years, ships from different countries set sail against the blockade. Each voyage was a quiet declaration of not forgetting and not giving up.

memory.title: Global Intifada
memory.desc: Millions took to the streets in cities around the world. Universities, squares and campuses became the new centres of solidarity.

memory.title: International Sumud Flotilla
memory.desc: Setting sail again in the spirit of sumud (steadfastness), the flotilla showed that civilian will against the blockade persists with determination.

quotes.text: Climate justice cannot be separated from the struggle against colonialism, occupation and injustice. We stand in solidarity with the Palestinian people.
quotes.author: Greta Thunberg

quotes.text: Civilians always pay the price of war. For peace and justice we must not be silent, but raise our voices.
quotes.author: Nina Potarska

quotes.text: On the Mavi Marmara we learned: conscience travels beyond the seas. Solidarity is not a choice, it is a debt.
quotes.author: Erdinç Tekir

quotes.text: The question of Palestine is, above all, a question of human rights. Law loses its meaning unless it stands with the oppressed.
quotes.author: Noura Erakat

dar-agaci.keyDesc: Bars imprison the body; awareness and solidarity climb over walls.
dar-agaci.quoteFr: «Condamné à mort ! Voilà cinq semaines que j'habite avec cette pensée, toujours seul avec elle, toujours glacé par sa présence, toujours courbé sous son poids !»
dar-agaci.quoteLocal: "Condemned to death! For five weeks I have lived with this thought, always alone with it, always frozen by its presence, always bent beneath its weight."
dar-agaci.quoteAuthor: Victor Hugo, The Last Day of a Condemned Man

sayilarla.aksaP1: The first qibla of Islam and the heart of Jerusalem, held sacred by the three Abrahamic faiths. Witness to many civilisations throughout history, Al-Aqsa remains a symbol of the struggle for freedom and dignity today.
sayilarla.aksaP2: In the face of access restrictions, raids and attempts to alter the status quo, the protection of the sanctuary has become one of the shared calls of solidarity worldwide.

cocuk.workshopBody: In this workshop at the Children's Tent, children will freely express their feelings through drawing, poetry and storytelling. Creative activities on themes of peace and solidarity will be held alongside volunteer pedagogues and educators. Little hands are drawing the greatest hope.
cocuk.wallDesc: Leave a short message; let colourful notes take their place on the wall.

kutuphane.ctaTitle: We Grow the Resource Pool Together
kutuphane.ctaBody: The library grows through community curation. Every resource you suggest (video, article, book, infographic) is first reviewed by a volunteer team, then published. Suggest your resource below and vote for the ones you find most useful.
